high_level_description: The image depicts a large, ornate building with a distinct Asian architectural style, likely of Tibetan or Buddhist origin. The structure is multi-tiered with intricate golden decorations and a prominent golden wheel at the top, which is a symbol often associated with Buddhism, representing the Dharma Wheel or Dharmachakra. The building has a combination of white and gold colors, with the upper sections being predominantly gold and the lower sections white. There are several windows and doors, some of which have red accents.
